method: Offline Chromium touch emulation, trusted taps and explicit ?test=1 fixtures. Includes failure injection; not physical phone validation.

steps.name: seven phone sizes have immediately reachable inventory and detail exits
placement cancel and close/reopen keep inventory selectable and unchanged
success toast does not cover nearby text, warning or combat buttons
short phone reading remains visible with reachable exit and a live clock
short phone reload is visible on its button
nearby list picks the stackable item without moving; failure restores world and bag
quick therapy does not consume safe medicine; supply picker explicitly uses it
rotated safe restores from the durable checkpoint after refresh
manual rotation preview cancels unchanged and failed placement rolls back
desktop rotation preview can cancel, leave its tab and commit in both required sizes
actual v0.2.0 raid migrates once; old HTML refuses the rotated record without overwriting
